Exercise book prices to fall by 18% from December 1

cards.what_happened: The National Book Traders' Association announced that retail prices of all exercise books across the island will be reduced by 18% starting December 1. It says the nationwide reduction is a direct result of VAT exemptions and concessions proposed under the 2027 National Budget.
details: The National Book Traders' Association has announced that the retail prices of all exercise books across the island will be reduced by 18% starting December 1. The price reduction applies nationwide.

The association says the nationwide reduction comes as a direct result of the Value Added Tax (VAT) exemptions and concessions proposed under the 2027 National Budget. The announcement was reported by Newswire.
key_facts: National Book Traders' Association announced an 18% cut in retail prices of all exercise books.
The price reduction starts December 1 and applies across the island.
The cut is a direct result of VAT exemptions and concessions.
Those VAT exemptions and concessions are proposed under the 2027 National Budget.
The announcement was reported by Newswire.
cards.whats_next: Exercise book retail prices will be reduced by 18% starting December 1.
cards.blurb: Exercise books will cost 18% less from December 1, after VAT exemptions and concessions in the 2027 National Budget.
cards.spoken: Good evening. If you buy exercise books, there is some news for you. The National Book Traders' Association has announced that the retail prices of all exercise books across the island will be reduced by 18% starting December 1. That is a nationwide price reduction. The association says this cut comes as a direct result of the Value Added Tax, or VAT, exemptions and concessions proposed under the 2027 National Budget. So from December 1, every exercise book sold across the island will carry a price that is 18% lower. That is the announcement from the National Book Traders' Association, reported by Newswire.
